about_the_game:
🩸 Introduction

Step into the crimson streets of Edo’s pleasure district.
Play as the captivating oiran Kochou and face endless swarms of yokai in a world where elegance meets carnage.
Wield your deadly fan and dance through the blood-soaked night to restore balance to the Twelve Divine Spirits.
Experience a Japanese dark action RPG that blends beauty, brutality, and dopamine-fueled combat.Key Features

⚔️ Key Features

  • Genre: Japanese Dark Action Survival (Roguelite-inspired)

  • Playable Character: Oiran Kochou — an elegant yet deadly courtesan

  • Combat: Fast-paced battles with graceful fan strikes, deadly dance skills, and explosive area attacks

  • Stage Structure: 5 Normal / 5 Coin / 5 Hard stages (more coming in future updates)

  • Presentation: 3D world enhanced with Live2D expressions and cinematic blood effects

  • World Setting: The decadent beauty of Edo’s red-light district fused with yokai horror and ritualistic darkness

  • Playtime: Each stage lasts 7–8 minutes, designed for short but intense play sessions

🌸 Steam Features

  • Steam Achievements supported

  • Available in Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese

  • Controller not supported (keyboard and mouse recommended)

  • Frequent updates planned after release

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat scenes and mild blood effects when defeating enemies. No sexual content or nudity is present.
